title: Winter Wedding Ideas UK: Cosy Touches and Guest Photos | Albums.ink
desc: Winter wedding ideas for a UK December or January wedding: cosy venue touches, food, timings for early sunsets and one QR code for every guest photo.
h1: Winter wedding ideas for a cosy UK celebration
lead: Next to dresses and outfits, “winter wedding ideas”, “colors” and “venues” show up when you start typing “winter wedding”. Winter dates are often easier to book, and the season gives you candlelight, velvet and mulled wine. Here are practical ideas for a UK winter wedding – and how to get every guest’s photos afterwards.
body: ## Plan around the light
- In December the sun sets around 4pm in much of the UK, so many couples move the ceremony earlier.
- Schedule couple portraits soon after the ceremony while there is still daylight.
- Plan for rain and wind: umbrellas at the door, an indoor drinks reception.
## Cosy touches
- Candles, fairy lights and greenery: eucalyptus, holly, pine.
- Blankets or wraps on chairs for any outdoor moment.
- Mulled wine, hot chocolate or a mince pie station during the drinks reception.
- Deep colours: burgundy, forest green, navy, gold.
## Food and entertainment
- A hearty wedding breakfast: roasts, pies, sticky toffee pudding.
- A ceilidh or a band to keep everyone warm on the dance floor.
- A sparkler exit if your venue allows it.
## Every guest photo in one place
Guests take photos all day, especially in the evening by candlelight. With an event album on Albums you collect them in one place:
1. Create the album, e.g. “Emma & Tom – 14 December”.
2. Put the QR code on table cards, the seating plan or the bar.
3. Guests scan it with their phone camera and upload photos and videos in the browser – nothing to install.
4. Turn on Hold guest photos to approve uploads before they appear.
5. After the wedding, download the whole album as one ZIP file.
Guests who upload without signing in appear anonymously. Signed-in guests also get a private draft copy with only their own uploads.

faq: What time should a winter wedding start?
Many couples start earlier, around midday or early afternoon, to get daylight for photos before sunset.
Do guests need to install anything?
No. They scan the QR code and upload in the browser.
Can we check photos before they appear?
Yes. With Hold guest photos, uploads appear only after you approve them.
How long are the photos kept?
6 months from the first upload, and the album can be extended.
